A.decision: How much energy to nominate for each of the next 28 days, per region
A.too_low: Buy the gap on the spot market at about three times the contract price
A.too_high: Resell the surplus at about half price

B.decision: On which day of next week feeder F017 can be taken out for maintenance
B.too_low: Neighbouring feeders overload on the chosen day: customers lose supply
B.too_high: A safe day is refused and the maintenance waits

C.decision: How much transformer capacity to add in Al-Rimal over three years
C.too_low: The peak summer day exceeds capacity: load shedding
C.too_high: Capital spent a year or two early
